sentences.text:
Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.
The present petition alleges wilful disobedience and non-compliance of the order dated 22.12.2025 passed in CRL.M.C. No.2424/2020 and other connected matters.

The said order was passed in proceedings emanating from complaints filed by the petitioner resulting in FIR No.156/2019 dated 10.05.2019 registered at PS Mayur Vihar Phase-I, Delhi under Section 420, 409,
506, 120-B, 34 IPC against the respondent nos.1, 3 to 5.
4.

During the course of the said proceedings i.e., CRL.M.C. No.2424/2020, the parties entered into a settlement agreement dated 20.04.2022.
5.
It is pursuant to the aforesaid settlement agreement that the order This is a digitally signed order.

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioner has paid the principal amount as agreed by the parties in settlement dated 20.04.2022 and the interest amount of 85,00,000/- will be paid within a period of three months.
xxx xxx xxx 17.

The Respondents are, however, directed to pay a sum of 85,00,000/- to the complainant(s) within a period of three months from date."
6.
Despite the aforesaid directions, the respondents have not paid the amount of Rs.85 Lakhs.

7. Prima facie, the respondents are guilty of wilful breach of the undertaking as incorporated in Paragraph 10 of the order 22.12.2025, thereby committing contempt under Section 2(b) read with Section 12 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971.
8.
Issue notice.
9. Learned counsel, as aforesaid, accepts notice on behalf of the respondents.

10. Let the aforesaid directions regarding the payment of Rs.85 Lakhs be complied with immediately.
11.
Let a compliance affidavit be filed by the respondents within a period of four weeks from today.
In any event of non-compliance, the respondent nos.3 to 5 shall remain present in the Court on the next date of hearing.
SACHIN DATTA, J MARCH 30, 2026/r
